name: El Celler de Can Roca
tier: THE BERTHS · THE STARS
recognition: MICHELIN Guide Spain 2026: three stars, held since 2009; forty years open in 2026
what_to_order: Menú Festival|Forty-dish anniversary menu|Olives caramelitzades|Gamba de Palamós marinada|Josep Roca's wine pairing|Jordi Roca's perfume desserts
price_range: Call ahead: no 2026 menu price found; the old record's pairing figure (EUR 155) is unconfirmed (seen Oct 2026)
reservation: Online only via the own site; dates open up to 11 months ahead, released at midnight CET on the 1st of each month; waiting list for full dates; card guarantee, charge for no-show or cancellation inside 10 days.
notes: The full tasting: caramelised olives plucked from a bonsai, closing on Jordi's perfume-built desserts.
verdict: For the one guest dinner a trip is planned around. Take the Festival menu with Josep's pairing, and ask on booking whether the forty-dish anniversary menu is running on your date.
caveat: Plan around the first-of-month booking release, not the trip. The 2026 menu price and the anniversary menu's dates and price were not found.
hot_this_month: The MICHELIN Spain 2027 stars are announced on 24 November in Huesca; send any date request before then (checked 20 Oct 2026).

name: Restaurant Massana
tier: THE STARS
recognition: MICHELIN Guide Spain 2026: one star, held since 2007; forty years open in September 2026
what_to_order: Homenatge al Magret d'Ànec (1986)|Caneló de pularda, escamarlà i crema de ceba dolça|Ceps, gambes i tòfona|Ou estrellat
price_range: Call ahead: no 2026 menu price found (seen Oct 2026)
reservation: Book ahead; one guide advises three to four weeks for weekend dinners.
notes: Homenaje al Magret de Pato — duck breast off the grill, on the card since 1986.
verdict: For guests who want a starred dinner in town without an eleven-month wait. Order the magret first, then the caneló or, in autumn, the cep and truffle plate.
caveat: Old record gives closed Sunday and Monday; not re-confirmed in 2026. The star list for 2027 is announced on 24 November 2026.
hot_this_month: Near the Devesa, where the Sant Narcís funfair stands 23 Oct-1 Nov; book days ahead, and ask when the winter truffle menu starts (record).

name: Divinum
tier: THE STARS
recognition: MICHELIN Guide Spain 2026: one star, first awarded in the 2025 guide (November 2024)
what_to_order: Steak tartare|Menú Essència with wine pairing|Menú Petit|Cheese trolley|Fig-leaf flan
price_range: Call ahead: no 2026 menu price found; old record's EUR 160 menu and EUR 90 pairing unconfirmed (seen Oct 2026)
notes: The classic steak tartare, mustard-cool, with whatever Laura pours against it.
verdict: For guests who choose dinner by the wine list. Start with the tartare finished at the table, then let the sommelier match the Essència menu.
caveat: The room is below street level and easy to miss. Old record gives closed Sunday and Monday; not re-confirmed in 2026.

name: Esperit Roca
neighborhood: Sant Julià de Ramis · the fort (10 km N)
address: Castell de Sant Julià de Ramis, Muntanya dels Sants Metges, Carrer Major s/n, 17481 Sant Julià de Ramis, Girona
tier: THE ROCA LADDER — FORT, BISTRO, THE PARENTS' BAR
recognition: MICHELIN Guide Spain: one star since the 2025 guide, kept in 2026; OAD 2026 No. 8 new restaurants in Europe (via Pearl)
what_to_order: Toda la gamba (2012)|Mar y montaña vegetal (2007)|Brioche de pularda|Libro viejo (2017)|Ginebra de Té de Roca
price_range: Call ahead: Ara (Dec 2025) gives EUR 140 sweet menu and EUR 170 savoury; Time Out gives EUR 139 and EUR 170 (seen Oct 2026)
notes: Toda la gamba — Palamós red prawn marinated in seaweed vinegar and katsuobushi; prawn velouté, sauce of the head, crisp legs, citric caviar, a concentrated distillate of the coral.
verdict: For guests who cannot get into El Celler but want its classics. Go at lunch for the view and take the savoury menu for Toda la gamba.
caveat: Needs a car or taxi up the hill. Two menus only; the 2027 star list comes out on 24 November 2026. Hours and the 3-11 Nov 2026 holiday closure in the old record were not re-confirmed.
hot_this_month: Closed for holidays 3-11 November 2026, so plan a lunch at the fort for the last days of October or after the 11th (record, checked 20 Oct 2026).

name: Normal
tier: THE ROCA LADDER — FORT, BISTRO, THE PARENTS' BAR
recognition: Guía Repsol: one Sol (first awarded 2024); MICHELIN Guide plate
what_to_order: Truita Sacha amb carpaccio de gamba vermella|Croqueta de llet d'ovella i pernil ibèric|Filet Wellington de vedella madurada|Els arrossos|Tarta al whisky amb gelat de rovell d'ou
price_range: EUR 35-60 per person (Guía Repsol listing, seen Oct 2026)
notes: The whisky tart with egg-yolk ice cream — the one dessert the inspectors single out.
verdict: The Roca room for an ordinary lunch at a fair price. Order the croquettes, the Sacha-style prawn omelette and the whisky cake.
caveat: Closed Monday; Tuesday disputed between sources. Old record's 90-day booking window and EUR 50 cancellation charge not re-confirmed.

name: Can Roca
tier: THE ROCA LADDER — FORT, BISTRO, THE PARENTS' BAR
recognition: The Roca parents' bar since 1967, where El Celler's brigade eats lunch
what_to_order: Menú del dia|Rap a la marinera|Calamars a la romana|Postres casolans
price_range: Call ahead: menú EUR 16 (Hola, Jul 2025) or EUR 18 (old record, Oct 2025); no 2026 figure found (seen Oct 2026)
reservation: Not taken, per user reports; arrive at the start of a sitting.
notes: The menú's fish day — rap a la marinera, monkfish yielding under a dense marinera sauce that asks for bread.
verdict: For crew who want the Roca story at bar prices. Go for the weekday menú, ideally on fish day, and do not expect the brothers.
caveat: A plain neighbourhood bar 25 minutes' walk from the Barri Vell, weekday lunch only per older sources. No 2026-dated listing found; ring before crossing town.

name: Can Marquès
tier: THE BERTHS · THE OLD HOUSES
recognition: Four generations of one family, opened 1920 beside the site of the Mercat del Lleó (Time Out)
what_to_order: L'arròs del dijous|Botifarra de sal i pebre amb formatge brie|Magret d'ànec amb salsa de porto|Bacallà amb samfaina i romesco|Escudella i carn d'olla
price_range: Set lunch EUR 14.50 per Time Out (undated, seen Oct 2026)
notes: The Thursday rice — the pan carries whatever the market gave up that morning.
verdict: For crew shopping the Lleó who want a working lunch nearby. Go on a Thursday for the rice; expect slow service when it is full.
caveat: Lunch is the main service and dinner nights are disputed. Recent reviews mix praise for the food with complaints about slow service and value.
hot_this_month: Lunch beside the market during the fair; dinners are only a few nights a week, so book for the Sant Narcís evenings (record).

name: Casa Marieta
tier: THE OLD HOUSES
recognition: Same family since 1892, five generations; centenary restaurant (own site)
what_to_order: Ànec amb peres|Canelons Casa Marieta|Espatlla de xai al forn|Bacallà amb mousselina d'all|Sípia amb pèsols|Xuixo de Girona
price_range: EUR 20-30 per person (Gastroranking, seen Oct 2026)
notes: Duck with pears: the old Catalan way, pears gone amber in the roasting juices.
verdict: For a relaxed lunch on the square with guests who want the classics. Order duck with pears and finish with the xuixo; book a terrace table.
caveat: Traditional, broad menu, not a place for new cooking; reviews are mixed on seasoning.

name: Fonda Cal Ros
address: Carrer de la Cort Reial 9, 17004 Girona
phone: Call ahead: +34 972 219 176 (old record, Arrival Guides) or +34 972 62 10 17 (Arrival Guides)
tier: THE OLD HOUSES
recognition: Opened April 2025 by the Gascons family of Els Tinars, one MICHELIN star (Ara)
what_to_order: Arròs a la llauna de peix de roca|Embotits de Toni Seli|Canelons de rostit|Bacallà amb festucs i olives|Porró de vi|Crema catalana cremada
price_range: EUR 45-60 per person (Gastroranking, seen Oct 2026)
reservation: Advisable; call ahead for lunch (Gastroranking). Carte or set menu.
notes: Rockfish rice a la llauna — baked flat in its tin until the edges catch.
verdict: For a group dinner that wants Catalan basics done properly. Share the charcuterie and the rice a la llauna, and drink from the porró.
caveat: Closing days unconfirmed and two phone numbers circulate. Plates are for sharing; reviews mention slow service.

name: Dit i Fet
tier: THE NEW ROOMS — WHERE THE CHEFS EAT, AND A GARDEN
recognition: Joan Roca names it his place to eat in Girona (Infobae, 2025); MICHELIN plate 2026 (via Pearl)
what_to_order: Tortilla cremosa de gamba de Palamós|Croquetes de rabo|Crestes de gall amb múrgoles|Tartar de vieira, oliva i piparra|Cap i pota|Xuixo a la brasa
price_range: Call ahead: EUR 40-55 per person (Planomato) vs about EUR 80 (diner review) (seen Oct 2026)
reservation: Book ahead; about 35 seats at twelve tables.
notes: ★ Tortilla cremosa de gamba de Palamós — a barely-set omelette running with Palamós red prawn, the coast folded into eggs (€24).
verdict: For food-minded crew and chefs who want Celler training without the tasting menu. Order the Palamós prawn omelette and the oxtail croquettes, and book.
caveat: Closed Tuesday and Wednesday. Short seasonal card, so dishes rotate; few vegetarian options per reviews.

name: SAFO
tier: THE NEW ROOMS — WHERE THE CHEFS EAT, AND A GARDEN
recognition: Joan Roca: friends and neighbours, very good natural wines (Infobae, 2025); Cuiner award 2024
what_to_order: Crispy octopus quesadilla, avocado cream|Partridge pâté with sour apple|Mackerel|Stracciatella galette with grilled bimi|Natural wine by the glass
price_range: About EUR 50 per person with wine (Ara 2024, seen Oct 2026)
notes: ★ Crispy octopus quesadilla with avocado cream — Richter's Mexico–Catalunya axis in a single bite.
verdict: For crew and chefs who drink natural wine and like a card that changes weekly. Tell Víctor what you like and order the octopus quesadilla if it is on.
caveat: The one-page card changes constantly. Old record's hours (own site, 2026) not re-confirmed; summer runs dinner only.

name: Nomo Girona
neighborhood: Barri Vell · Pujada de la Mercè
tier: THE NEW ROOMS — WHERE THE CHEFS EAT, AND A GARDEN
recognition: Diner reviews on OpenTable dated April and June 2026; opening covered by El Punt Avui, October 2021
what_to_order: Menú Naoyuki|Sukiyaki croquette|Ebi chili|Pop (octopus)|Yuzu mochi with white chocolate
price_range: EUR 30 and under per OpenTable; Menú Naoyuki EUR 50 (seen Oct 2026)
reservation: Book via OpenTable or by phone; garden tables go first in summer
notes: Menú Naoyuki — the chef-partner's fourteen-course €50 set run, truffled edamame through yuzu mochi
verdict: Book a garden table for a relaxed Japanese dinner and take the Menú Naoyuki if everyone is hungry. Not the choice for a chef-driven Catalan meal.
caveat: One branch of a Catalan group whose Naoyuki menu also runs in Barcelona and Madrid; no Michelin or Repsol listing. A 2026 reviewer found the tasting courses came too fast.

name: Restaurant 8de7
tier: THE MENÚ DEL DIA
recognition: Closed-choice lunch menú on Carrer de les Hortes since late 2014; 2026 reviews on Gastroranking
what_to_order: Patates braves 8de7|Menú de migdia|Arròs del dia|Canelons
price_range: Lunch menú about EUR 15 on an undated guide; Saturday menú about EUR 19.50 per the old record (seen Jul 2026)
notes: Patates braves 8de7 — the house's own reinvention and standing dare: 'no n'heu vist cap d'iguals' — you will not have seen their like.
verdict: For a weekday lunch on a budget: book, take the menú and add the house patates braves. Skip it if you want à-la-carte freedom at midday.
caveat: The room is small and the lunch menú is closed-choice; the Guía Repsol Solete in the old record could not be confirmed (the Solete found on this street belongs to Probocador at No. 7).

name: Tornés (Pastisseria Tornés)
tier: THE BERTHS · THE MENÚ DEL DIA
recognition: Millor Xuixo del Món 2026 (6th edition), won by Josep Maria Tornés; Fava d'Or 2026, seventh year in a row
what_to_order: Xuixo de crema|Coca de fruita|Menú de migdia|Xocolata desfeta
price_range: Lunch about EUR 20 with pastry dessert per a customer review; old record EUR 14.50 weekdays, EUR 16.50 Sat (seen Jul 2026)
reservation: Walk-in; order xuixos ahead, they sell out
notes: The dessert buffet — individual portions of the day's house pastry, included in a €14.50-odd menú; the finish is the point.
verdict: Come at lunch for the menú and finish at the counter, or call in mid-morning for a xuixo before they sell out. Not worth the walk for the room alone.
caveat: A shopping street in the south Eixample, not the old town; the dessert buffet in the old record is described by one reviewer as a choice of one pastry, so expect that rather than a buffet. No menú on Sundays.

name: Xocolateria L'Antiga
tier: THE MORNING — THE GRANJA AND THE FORK
recognition: Chocolate house on Plaça del Vi since 1916; listed in the Ajuntament's Establiments Emblemàtics catalogue (per old record)
what_to_order: Xocolata desfeta amb melindros|Xocolata suïssa|Coca casolana|Crema catalana|Entrepà de fuet
price_range: Café prices, a few euros a cup (seen Jul 2026)
notes: Xocolata desfeta amb melindros — near-black, spoon-coating, under the arcades
verdict: A morning or late-afternoon stop for xocolata desfeta with melindros, best on the terrace. Not the place for specialty coffee or a full breakfast.
caveat: The rest of the menu is deliberately plain, and Sunday opening is unclear because three published schedules disagree.
hot_this_month: On the Plaça del Vi, where the correfoc runs on Saturday 24 October at 22:30: a cup of xocolata desfeta before the fire (checked 20 Oct 2026).

name: Ca l'Àngel
address: Ctra. de Banyoles a Figueres, 29, 17833 Fontcoberta (urb. Melianta)
tier: THE MORNING — THE GRANJA AND THE FORK
recognition: ElNacional.cat, January 2025: the best esmorzar de forquilla in the Pla de l'Estany (per old record; not re-found)
what_to_order: Cap i pota|Botifarra amb mongetes|Mandonguilles amb bolets|Estofat de peix amb patates i pèsols|Xuixo a la brasa amb ratafia
price_range: Weekday lunch menú EUR 16 per old record; breakfast prices not published (seen Jul 2026)
notes: Cap i pota at breakfast — the forquilla litmus test, with bread and a glass of red
verdict: Worth the 15-minute drive for anyone who wants a proper Catalan fork breakfast: order cap i pota and finish with the flambéed xuixo. Not for a late riser or a Sunday.
caveat: A plain roadside bar in a residential estate: you need a car, it shuts Sundays and holidays and at noon on Saturdays.
hot_this_month: Meatballs with wild mushrooms and a ratafia-flambéed xuixo for an autumn fork breakfast; closed on the 1 November holiday (record).

name: La Fàbrica
neighborhood: Barri Vell · Carrer de la Llebre
tier: THE MORNING — THE GRANJA AND THE FORK
recognition: Opened March 2015 by Christian and Amber Meier; beans roasted at their Espresso Mafia
what_to_order: Flat white|Single-origin filter|Nordic bagel|Pulled pork bagel|Cinnamon bun
price_range: EUR 10-18 for brunch (seen Jul 2026)
reservation: Walk-in; expect a wait at weekend brunch
notes: The brunch board with a filter coffee — beans they roast themselves at Espresso Mafia.
verdict: Order a flat white and a bagel after a morning walk; at weekend brunch expect a queue. For crew on a day off, not for a quick takeaway at peak time.
caveat: No 2026-dated review found; closing time is disputed (15:00 vs 17:00) and there is no evening service.

name: Can Castelló
tier: XUIXO, CHOCOLATE AND A CONE
recognition: Xuixo family since 1898, Establecimiento Histórico; the first xuixo-only shop (Time Out)
what_to_order: Xuixo de crema|Xuixo de crema de ratafia|Xuixo de cabell d'àngel
price_range: EUR 3-4 per xuixo (seen Jul 2026)
notes: The classic crema xuixo, eaten warm — sugar crust cracking into soft crema catalana.
verdict: Buy a warm crema xuixo to eat on the street, then a ratafia one to compare. For the 2026 contest winner, walk to Tornés instead.
caveat: A branded shop rather than the old bakery: frying happens in Banyoles. A Time Out English guide still says Can Castelló closed in 2014, which refers to the old pastisseria.

name: Casa Cacao
tier: XUIXO, CHOCOLATE AND A CONE
recognition: Opened 15 February 2020: Jordi Roca's chocolate workshop, café and hotel
what_to_order: Xocolata calenta|Xuixo Casa Cacao|Fartonne|Single-origin bars|Rooftop brunch
price_range: Café EUR 15-30; rooftop brunch EUR 35 or EUR 55, sources in the old record disagree (seen Jul 2026)
reservation: Shop and café walk-in; brunch and rooms book ahead
notes: The thick hot chocolate — single-origin, conched metres away, dense enough to coat the spoon.
verdict: Stop for a thick hot chocolate and a chocolate xuixo, and buy single-origin bars to take aboard. Book separately if you want the rooftop brunch.
caveat: A café and shop, not a lunch room; brunch price and start time are disputed between sources.

name: Rocambolesc
address: Call ahead: Carrer de Santa Clara 50, 17001 Girona (Time Out, original shop); Pearl, En Primeur Club and Jet2 give Carrer de les Hortes, which Time Out gives for the Bikineria
tier: XUIXO, CHOCOLATE AND A CONE
recognition: Opinionated About Dining Cheap Eats Europe: No. 43 (2023), No. 34 (2024), No. 60 (2025)
what_to_order: Panet|Baked-apple soft-serve|Rocanas|Mano Dorada
price_range: EUR 4-8 (seen Jul 2026)
notes: The Panet — brioche pressed hot around cold soft-serve; crackling crust, frozen heart.
verdict: The cheapest way to taste the Roca kitchen: a panet or a baked-apple soft-serve, walk-in. Go early on summer evenings to beat the queue.
caveat: Address and hours differ between listings; check the own site before sending guests.

name: Mercat del Lleó
address: Plaça de Francesc Calvet i Rubalcaba, 15, 17002 Girona
tier: THE MARKET, THE CHEESE, THE CELLAR
recognition: Municipal covered market, opened 3 November 1944
what_to_order: Costa Brava fish at Peixateria Salvador|Botifarra dolça|Poma de Girona IGP|Bacallà at Món Salat|Mas Alba goat cheeses|Bolets
price_range: Market prices
notes: Day-boat Costa Brava fish off the Salvador counter — bright-eyed, stiff, smelling of the sea.
verdict: Go early, before ten, to provision the galley: day-boat fish, botifarra, Girona apples and local goat's cheese. A working market, not a place to graze.
caveat: Shut Sundays and winding down by early afternoon; Friday-afternoon opening is unconfirmed. Not the Mercat de la Lleona flea market.
hot_this_month: Poma de Girona apples and Garrotxa cheese on the farm stalls; it usually hosts the new Empordà oil presentation in mid-December (14 Dec in 2024).

name: Cal Formatger
neighborhood: Barri Vell · Carrer de la Cort Reial
address: Carrer de la Cort Reial 12, 17004 Girona
tier: THE MARKET, THE CHEESE, THE CELLAR
recognition: Guía Repsol (updated Nov 2025): Joan Roca's favourite cheese shop in Girona; Formaticum next door holds a Solete
what_to_order: Les Safates|Puigpedrós (Molí de Ger)|Glauc (Formatgeria Xauxa)|Tou del Lluçanès|Cervesa Minera
price_range: Boards EUR 25-55 (seen Jul 2026)
notes: The Girona-comarca board, cut to order — start with the grey-rinded, hazelnut-sweet goat's cheeses.
verdict: Ask for a board of Girona-province cheeses and a few wedges vacuum-packed for the galley. Ring ahead for a private tasting.
caveat: Closed Sunday and Monday; tastings need notice. Nothing dated 2026 found.

name: Espelt Viticultors
tier: THE MARKET, THE CHEESE, THE CELLAR
recognition: About 200 ha of organic DO Empordà vines; Decántalo profile of Anna Espelt, August 2026
what_to_order: Airam|La Vella|Coma Bruna|Sauló|Garnatxa de l'Empordà
price_range: Tours EUR 27-38 a head (seen Jul 2026)
notes: Airam: grandfather Lluís's solera Garnatxa — gold shading to red, every vintage since 1997.
verdict: A half-day out from Girona for a chef or a guest who cares about Empordà wine: book the vineyard tour and leave with Garnatxa de l'Empordà for the galley.
caveat: About fifty minutes from Girona, and tours run on set dates only, thin outside August.

name: Zanpanzar
neighborhood: Barri Vell · Carrer de la Cort Reial
address: Carrer de la Cort Reial, 10-12, 17004 Girona
tier: LATE — AFTER SERVICE
recognition: Basque pintxo counter on Cort Reial since 28 December 1999; reviews dated March-April 2026
what_to_order: Txistorra pintxo|Tortilla pintxo|Pulpo a la gallega|Patatas bravas|Cachopo
price_range: About EUR 2.50 a pintxo, indicative (seen Jul 2026)
verdict: For crew after service: arrive by 23:00, take txistorra and tortilla off the trays, then bravas. Earlier in the evening the counter is fuller.
caveat: The May 2025 change of hands and the new team's names could not be confirmed in any trusted source; midnight is the hard stop.

name: König Sandwiches
neighborhood: Barri Vell · Plaça de Sant Feliu
tier: LATE — AFTER SERVICE
recognition: Ara, May 2024: the Girona restaurant that sells more braves than water
what_to_order: Patates braves|Hamburger|Frankfurt|König 1973 beer
price_range: Fast-casual prices (seen Jul 2026)
verdict: A late, cheap plate of braves and a burger when the kitchens have closed; judge it as fast food, not as a restaurant.
caveat: Fast food on trays, with lunchtime waits and mixed reviews on cleanliness; hours differ between branches.

name: Sunset Jazz Club
address: Carrer de Jaume Pons i Martí, 12, 17004 Girona
tier: LATE — AFTER SERVICE
recognition: Listed by DownBeat among the world's best jazz clubs, reported by Ara on 25 February 2026
what_to_order: A drink at the bar|Jazz a la Fresca first drink
price_range: Drinks; a EUR 5 supplement if summer gigs move indoors (seen Jul 2026)
reservation: Walk-in; arrive at doors on name nights
verdict: The late-night answer for anyone who wants music with the last drink: check the programme, arrive at doors on name nights. Eat first; there is no kitchen.
caveat: No food at all, and a room of about 50 fills fast; Wednesday is missing from the posted hours.
